title: Monitors in Black: Self-Verifying Incident Response for LLM Services
description: Built for the Agents of SigNoz hackathon. A SigNoz alert fires on one of six injected LLM-service failures (latency, error bursts, token bloat, memory growth, retry loops, lost traffic). Four agents read traces, logs and metrics through the SigNoz API and apply a fix only from a hard allowlist at 0.6 confidence or higher. A case closes only after two clean telemetry readings, so a fix that cannot be verified goes to a human instead of being marked resolved.
